Publish.LongDescription:
Stops cars and motorcycles from choosing street parking in the whole city.
## Features - Enabled with the Options menu [x] toggle. - Private vehicles still park in parking lots and spaces included with some buildings.
## Good to know - It could take a few city months for already parked cars to move. Vanilla road upgrades that remove street parking clear the affected road faster. - A few cars may remain temporarily after road construction while the game updates parking lanes and paths. - If the city does not have enough parking facilities, the game handles the overflow normally, including use of outside-connection (hidden) storage. - Safe to remove: streets return to vanilla parking. - This does not delete cars or affect bicycles, it just prevents street parking.
## Support and Feedback - Please consider using the like button if the mod is useful. - Feedback and pull requests are welcome through the GitHub and Discord links.
